topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecturer, the overarching themes of the lecture series, and the specific learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Conceptual Frameworks and Epidemiological Evidence for Cancer Causation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of cancer etiology by examining the interplay between endogenous genetic processes, environmental exposures, and global epidemiological variations.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogenic Agents, Initiation, and Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how diverse biological, physical, and chemical agents induce or promote cancer through direct mutagenesis, metabolic conversion, or microenvironmental inflammation.

topics.label: Methods for Determining Carcinogenicity and Assessing Risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the sequencing, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro methodologies used to detect carcinogen exposure and evaluate cancer risk.
